records.summary: Added Coinbase's first-party cbXRP proof-of-reserves snapshot: 151,405,263.6 XRP reserves backing 151,403,016.069 cbXRP on Base, 100.001484% derived coverage and 2,247.531 XRP surplus. The page lists 20 XRPL reserve addresses; their displayed balances sum to 151,405,263.598 XRP, only 0.002 below the displayed total. No exact address matches the five Binance incident source wallets. Coinbase's March 31 digital-asset disclosure marks XRP and cbXRP held/commercially engaged; Coinbase defines commercial engagement broadly and gives no amounts. Coinbase Help confirms cbXRP is Base-only and 1:1 backed, with regional send/receive restrictions including Japan and New York. This is a direct institutional custody/collateral rail, not a price-demand feature. No forecast issued.
